description: Connect a personal Epic account from Settings > Account > Connections and import its games with resumable inventory, catalogue and playtime steps.
name: Epic Games Library

permissions.rationale: Import games into the authenticated user's library and update provider metadata, playtime and availability while preserving personal state.
Exchange the user's Epic authorization code and contact Epic's account, library and catalogue services through the bounded host network gateway.
Keep each user's rotating Epic tokens private and save resumable inventory/import checkpoints inside this plugin's storage.
List Epic Games on the Connections page so you can connect, import and disconnect from a popup there.
